newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle trade at $114/dressed -private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle trade at $114/dressed -private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets near midday Thursday were trading light to moderate at $113.50 to $114.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, steady to down $1.00 from Wednesday's late sales, market sources said.
The $114.00/dressed top was down $2.00 from the bulk of last week's trade. About 10,000 head had sold by late morning, which brought the week to date estimate near 35,000 for the state, sources said.
On a live basis, sales were reported at $71.00 to mostly $72.00, with the top price unchanged from Wednesday, but down $1.00 from last week.
